text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp—training begins. Matikane 
Fukukitaru is preparing to face it with 
grim determination...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, heading into the Kikuka Sho, do 
you know what I'm lacking right now? Just 
give me the gist!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
How harsh! But yeah, you're totally right! 
Even if that was completely blunt!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"To begin with, no one in my family is a 
purebred stayer."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
On top of being unsuited for long 
distances, I have zero talent! Put those 
together, and it's a completely unbeatable 
formula for weakness!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Still, being able to get my hands on it 
even like this is pure luck! So anyway—"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to gather up every single shred 
of good luck at this training camp. So 
much that I won't even be able to hold it 
all!
choice_data_list: So what exactly are we going to do?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
First, the Hundred Shrine Visits. Let's 
find a shrine nearby and go pray...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait, at first glance, there isn't a 
shrine anywhere. In that case, what could 
work as a substitute for the hundred-visit 
prayer...?
choice_data_list: A hundred laps along the beach, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oho, I'll take that idea! As expected of 
you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Repetition is key when offering prayers! 
Now then, let's do a hundred laps along 
the beach!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Yaren soran, spinach, spinach-oh!" Yaren 
soran...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Yaren soran, spinach, spinach-oh!" Yaren 
soran...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving the Doppler effect trailing in her 
wake, Matikanefukukitaru ran lap after 
lap. Her quest to gather good fortune 
continued on...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A four-leaf clover... A four-leaf clover 
is...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Aaah, there it isss!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! That four-leaf bush clover, it's 
not a true clover, but it has four leaves!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The lucky seashell, where is the lucky 
seashell...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If I just dig away the sand around here 
with my feet... Heave-ho, heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, black water! Could this possibly 
be... oil!? Lucky me!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, starting today, I am Machikane 
Oil King!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's time for the final bit of luck 
gathering. We've done a lot, but I still 
feel like it's not quite enough.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, how do you think we can get our 
hands on the ultimate happiness to cap 
things off?
choice_data_list: Make a wish on a shooting star.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Golden scales! That sounds super lucky. I 
want to make it into a necklace and hang 
it around my neck!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
In that case, we need to look for fish. 
Ah, look, there are people seining over 
there!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, let me join in too! Are there 
any shiny gold fish around?! Wait, 
goldfish?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru took part in beach 
seine net fishing. She didn't find any 
golden scales, but she did build up her 
arm strength.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wishing upon a shooting star! What a great 
idea! On a southern island, we'll surely 
see plenty of stars. You must make a wish!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hmm, nobody's picking up...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Zzz... zzz...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, nothing tonight either... Not coming 
out...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Zzz... zzz...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It won't come out, it wo...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it appeared! We did it, Trainer-san! 
After 3 grueling days, we finally found 
it! Yay!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: ...Aah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the midst of sheer delight, the wish 
was forgotten. Even so, having waited so 
long built up perseverance.
